skill.displayName: 信创IT投标决策-信息化项目投标评估

llm.summary: This skill mostly matches its bid-analysis purpose, but it also asks the agent to register accounts, transmit a persistent device fingerprint, store an API key locally, and write report files by default.

dimensions.detail: The skill limits normal API traffic to two vendor domains and says local file contents are not uploaded, but automatic registration collects platform, architecture, and a deterministic hashed MAC address and sends them to a remote service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No separate installer was found; the package is a SKILL.md, references, and one Python renderer. Metadata only declares ZLBX_API_KEY, while runtime instructions disclose network access, local file reads, report writes, and credential storage outside the skill directory.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifacts include useful consent gates and call-budget limits, but they also instruct default HTML export, raw background API/command execution, absolute path disclosure, and fixed promotional/referral output.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill persists an API key in ~/.zlbx/config.json and writes reports under ~/zlbx-bid-decision-files/; the credential-storage instructions do not require restrictive permissions, atomic writes, or symlink protections.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The procurement-data queries and bid-decision workflow are purpose-aligned, but the auto-registration, recharge-link generation, device fingerprinting, credential persistence, and mandatory commercial follow-up broaden the skill beyond analysis.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using the vendor's cloud service for bid analysis, spending account credits, storing a reusable API key in a plaintext local config file, and sharing a hashed device identifier during automatic trial registration. Prefer configuring ZLBX_API_KEY yourself to avoid the auto-registration path, and review generated HTML links before sharing reports.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Local reading of user-provided bid files and report writing are disclosed and coherent with report generation, but the manifest only declares an environment variable, so users should review the runtime file access details.
[TP4] expected: HTML report generation is directly disclosed in SKILL.md and report-template.md and is part of the reporting workflow, so this is not tool poisoning by itself; the concern is that export is default in full mode.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The auto-registration and account lifecycle flow is disclosed and consent-gated, but it materially expands the analysis skill into account creation, credential storage, quota handling, and recharge flows.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The hashed MAC collection is explicitly described, but it is a stable hardware-derived identifier and the artifacts understate its tracking significance by calling it non-identifying.
[SQP-2] expected: Generating an HTML report is expected for this reporting skill, but doing it by default in full mode creates persistent local files without a separate opt-in at export time.
[E1] unexpected: External API use is expected, but transmitting the device-feature payload for automatic registration is not necessary for bid analysis and depends on informed user consent.
[T01] unexpected: The fixed commercial footer and post-report referrals are disclosed in the artifacts, but they alter the output toward affiliated services even when the user asked for analysis.
[T09] unexpected: The report renderer escapes HTML text but does not validate URL schemes before placing API-supplied URLs in clickable target=_blank links; exploitation would require a malicious or poisoned URL and user interaction.
